jobs.name: facebook-profile
jobs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: Dear Body Philippines Facebook profile image, square 1:1, carefully readable inside a circular crop.
Input image 1 is the authoritative existing brand mark: the thin circular db monogram with PH at lower left in silver on burgundy. Preserve the exact identity, letterform construction, PH placement and outer ring, rather than designing another logo. Images 2 and 3 are mandatory visual style references only: playful bold warm social colors, premium approachable tactile photography; do not copy their layouts, products, text or people.
Create a vivid new photographed brand badge. A large perfectly frontal, flat round burgundy enamel disc carries the exact official monogram in pale warm cream with subtle physical embossed depth. Disc centered at (50%,50%), diameter about 77% of square. The official monogram itself occupies 64% of the square, clear wide strokes enough to read as an avatar but retain the original proportions. Warm rich orange lacquer background with a modest crescent of golden yellow at lower right and a coral reflected glint, crisp directional sunshine and a short realistic shadow; lively sophisticated pop-art color energy. All four square corners warm orange, no white outer margin. Disc face remains high-contrast dark burgundy. A frontal editorial product photograph of a tangible badge, not slanted, not a letter illustration. Keep the single logo perfectly centered and fully inside the circle-safe central 80%. Do not include scent bottles, any people, faces, jewelry, offer text, extra letters, DEAR BODY wordmark, invented trademarks or decorative marks. Only the supplied exact circular db / PH logo may appear. High resolution, sharply resolved edges, clean and memorable at small social avatar size.

jobs.name: facebook-cover
jobs.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: wide Facebook page cover photographic base for Dear Body Philippines, landscape approximately 2.28:1.
Input image 1 is the authoritative MOJITO METALLIQUE women's product bottle: preserve white/cream label, golden yellow liquid, correct name and logo. Image 2 is the authoritative OUD MIRAGE men's bottle: preserve black label with white lettering, blue liquid, correct name and logo. Images 3 and 4 are mandatory visual style references only. Reinterpret their playful, colorful, warm dominant, tight editorial fashion/product photography without copying any composition or person.
Scene: a realistic high-end overhead editorial photoshoot on a glossy burnt-orange/coral sunlit table. LEFT 0–29%: only a Filipino adult woman's hand with coral manicure and yellow ribbed cuff lifts the full Mojito bottle out of a burgundy red little pouch, with one cream-and-yellow headphone earcup partly cut off at the far edge; label square to camera. RIGHT 73–100%: only a Filipino adult man's hand with natural short nails and cream/orange striped shirt cuff holds the full Oud Mirage bottle beside a vivid cobalt canvas sling bag; a small chrome clip catches light. Both bodies are fully offscreen, hands enter from bottom corners. Every visible human belongs to the appropriate product line.
Middle 32–69% should be a clean warm golden-orange table field with subtle real texture and no props for a later typography overlay. Do not add any copy, logo overlay, taglines, decorative cards, or text except exact physical bottle labels. Warm colors occupy more than two thirds of image; cobalt and blue are small scent accents. Place bottle label centers near x23% and x80%, y51%, bottle complete height about53% of frame. Thick realistic glass bases, long narrow cylindrical 50ml bodies, fitted glossy black cylindrical caps entirely black including their lower edge, thin silver collars belonging only to glass bottle neck. Consistent realistic hand-to-bottle scale. Active natural grasp, plausible anatomy and no jewelry logos. Pronounced directional sunlight with clean playful diagonal shadows and tactile fabric, luminous amber and blue liquid, natural skin and photorealistic hands. Absolutely NO faces, head, chin, mouth, eyes, facial fragments, reflected faces, background people, screens or portraits anywhere. Not a collage or grid. One cohesive photographed still-life lifestyle scene. Energetic, approachable and premium; no generic beige portrait, no floating objects, no smoke, no duplicated bottles.
